download_models_cli: download Docling ML models to a specified output directory using the CLI download command
download_layout_model: download the layout detection model for document structure analysis
download_tableformer_model: download the tableformer model for table extraction from documents
download_code_formula_model: download the code and formula recognition model for OCR of technical content
download_all_models: download all available Docling models including smoldocling, granite vision, and easyocr
